stories.h: ICE arrests on SEA jet bridge spark airport protest
stories.s: Masked federal agents detained travelers boarding an Alaska flight Saturday; the Port says two passengers were arrested. Protesters marched through SEA Sunday as Gov. Ferguson and Rep. Randall condemned the operation; ICE alleges obstruction.

stories.h: Bremerton–Seattle fast ferry cuts five daily round trips
stories.s: Kitsap Transit canceled five departures from each terminal, including peak commute runs, through Dec. 1 while two boats are repaired or maintained. Rich Passage 1 is tentatively due back Dec. 2.

stories.h: Seattle sandbags South Park ahead of king tides
stories.s: Seattle Public Utilities lined the Duwamish with thousands of sandbags and barriers Sunday ahead of this week's high tides. SPU urges residents to sign up for AlertSeattle and keep a go-kit ready.

stories.h: Woman hurt as 80-plus shots fired in Pioneer Square
stories.s: Someone fired at a woman waiting in her parked car near Occidental Avenue S. Saturday night; she suffered minor injuries. Police found more than 80 shell casings and have no suspect yet.

coming.s: Seattle tides are predicted at 12.5 ft or higher Nov. 26-29, topping out near 12.7 ft Wednesday-Thursday; low-lying spots like South Park can see minor flooding.
